text:
alex: Quick postmortem follow-up — we had two near-identical regressions during canary windows last week. Proposing tighter small-batch rollout + explicit auto-rollback rules.

mira: sounds good. can you capture owners + deadlines? also we need the exact signal definitions that trigger rollback.

sam: +1 on small-batch. Proposal: rollback if error-rate increases by >=5 percentage points vs baseline for 3m consecutive, or p95 latency increases by >200ms for 2m. Also cap blast radius to 3% of total traffic during canary.

alex: sketching config prototype — will commit to repo and link the ticket.
```
feature_flag:
  rollout_strategy: small_batch
  batches: [1%, 3%, 10%]
  rollback_rules:
    - name: error_rate_spike
      metric: error_rate
      delta: 0.05
      window: 3m
    - name: latency_regression
      metric: p95_latency
      delta_ms: 200
      window: 2m
  max_blast_radius: 3%
  auto_rollback: enabled
```

mira: please add a sanity-check smoke test that runs after each batch and fails fast if schema/malformed responses increase. also document who owns alerts (pager vs slack).

jena: added a tracking card INF-4823 and linked the PM postmortem. Ownership suggested: sam -> rollback rule impl + smoke tests; alex -> rollout config + infra deploy; mira -> metrics/alerts/runbook. Deadline: tests by Tue EOD, infra review Wed, staged rollouts Thu.

sam: fine with owners. I'll push a PR for the smoke test and add a small synthetic workload that validates responses.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued by @alex: canary-config/v1.2 scheduled for 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC.

alex: PR link: https://internal.redwood/INF-4823/changeset. Note: keep defaults conservative in prod (batches capped at 1% initial).

mira: can we also record recurring incident patterns in the ticket? last 3 incidents point to model tokenizer changes and third-party model swaps during rollouts. Worth adding pre-rollout model version checks.

jena: agreed — added checklist item: verify model tokenizer/codec compatibility + run model-diff eval on canary slice.

sam: will also enable canary traffic isolation so blast radius doesn't cascade (circuit-breaker + tag routing).

alex: created calendar invite "Rollout Safety Review" quarterly; added action to review patterns and adjust default rollback thresholds.

mira: I'll author a short runbook snippet for on-call: how to interpret rollback signals, how to abort/override, and who to call for escalations.

sam: sounds good. closing notes: INF-4823 contains all action items and owners; I'll update PRs to reference it. :thumbsup:
